name: Environment Agency (UK) flood monitoring
summary: Live flood warnings and alerts for England, flood areas, and river, sea, groundwater and rainfall readings from Environment Agency monitoring stations.
notes: Keyless and free under the Open Government Licence v3.0; attribute as using Environment Agency flood and river level data from the real-time data API (Beta). No service-level guarantee; follow HTTP redirects.
Covers England only. Every endpoint is a GET returning JSON (items under 'items', paging under 'meta'); append .csv to a path for CSV.
Paging is _limit and _offset. Readings default to 500 rows and cap _limit at 10000; flood areas default to 500.
Do not poll station by station: the documented pattern for current values is one call to /data/readings?latest every 15 minutes.
Geographic filters take lat, long (WGS84 decimal degrees) and dist in kilometres, all three together.
Flood warning severityLevel: 1 severe flood warning, 2 flood warning, 3 flood alert, 4 warning no longer in force.

endpoints.name: List current flood warnings and alerts
endpoints.summary: Flood warnings and alerts in force in England, with severity, area, message and time raised.

min_severity.description: Only warnings at this severity or more severe (1 is most severe, 4 least).

county.description: Only warnings whose area touches this county name.

lat.description: Latitude of the centre of a search circle; use with long and dist.

long.description: Longitude of the centre of a search circle; use with lat and dist.

dist.description: Radius of the search circle in km.

notes: Lists only warnings currently in force; there is no history here.

endpoints.name: List flood alert and warning areas
endpoints.summary: The geographic areas warnings are issued for, with code, description, river or sea and polygon link.

lat.description: Latitude of the centre of a search circle; use with long and dist.

long.description: Longitude of the centre of a search circle; use with lat and dist.

dist.description: Radius of the search circle in km.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first area to return.

endpoints.name: Get one flood area
endpoints.summary: One flood alert or warning area by its code.

area_code.description: The flood area code (floodAreaID), as found on a warning.

endpoints.name: List monitoring stations
endpoints.summary: River level, flow, tidal, groundwater and rainfall stations, with location, river and the measures each reports.

parameter.description: Only stations measuring this parameter, by short name such as 'level', 'flow', 'wind' or 'temperature'.

qualifier.description: Only stations with a measure of this qualifier, e.g. 'Stage', 'Downstream Stage', 'Tidal Level', 'Groundwater'.

label.description: Only stations with this exact label.

stationReference.description: Only the station with this reference.

RLOIid.description: Only the station with this River Levels on the Internet id.

search.description: Only stations whose label contains this text.

lat.description: Latitude of the centre of a search circle; use with long and dist.

long.description: Longitude of the centre of a search circle; use with lat and dist.

dist.description: Radius of the search circle in km.

view.description: 'full' adds stage and downstage scale data.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first station to return.

endpoints.name: Get one monitoring station
endpoints.summary: A station's full description: location, river, measures, and typical and record levels (stageScale) where known.

endpoints.name: List readings across all stations
endpoints.summary: Readings from every measure, filtered by time, parameter or station; latest gives the current value of each.

latest.description: A flag: present (send an empty string) to return only the most recent reading of each measure.

today.description: A flag: present (send an empty string) to return today's readings.

startdate.description: Start of a date range, YYYY-MM-DD; use with enddate.

enddate.description: End of a date range, YYYY-MM-DD; use with startdate.

parameter.description: Only readings of this parameter, by short name such as 'level' or 'flow'.

qualifier.description: Only readings of measures with this qualifier.

stationReference.description: Only readings from this station reference.

station.description: Only readings from this station, given by its full URI.

sorted.description: A flag: present (send an empty string) to sort newest first.

limit.description: Maximum readings to return; default 500, maximum 10000.

notes: date, today or latest without a station or _sorted have no default limit and can return very large results; set _limit.

endpoints.name: List one station's readings
endpoints.summary: Readings for every measure at one station, for a day, a date range, since a time, or the latest.

latest.description: A flag: present (send an empty string) to return only the most recent reading of each measure.

today.description: A flag: present (send an empty string) to return today's readings.

startdate.description: Start of a date range, YYYY-MM-DD; use with enddate.

enddate.description: End of a date range, YYYY-MM-DD; use with startdate.

since.description: Readings strictly after this date-time (not inclusive), ISO 8601.

sorted.description: A flag: present (send an empty string) to sort newest first.

limit.description: Maximum readings to return; default 500, maximum 10000.
